content_sections.heading: DNH & DD AYUSH Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 30 vacancies have been announced. Panchakarma Technician posts account for 28 vacancies across Senior, Medium and Junior levels, while one vacancy each is available for Senior Medical Officer and Yoga Instructor.

content_sections.heading: DNH & DD AYUSH Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs according to the post. Candidates should check both the prescribed educational qualification and experience before submitting the application.

rows.qualification: BAMS with MD / MS in Panchakarma, Prasuti Tantra and Stree Roga, Shalya Tantra, Kayachikitsa, Kaumarbhritya or Shalakya Tantra from a recognised university / Statutory State Board / Council / Faculty of Indian Medicine. Enrolment on the Central Register or State Register of Indian System of Medicine is also required.
rows.experience: Essential: 5 years. Desirable: 10 years of clinical and/or teaching experience in a recognised hospital or teaching institution.
10 years of experience in Panchakarma techniques at a recognised Ayurveda Institute
5 years of experience in Panchakarma techniques at a recognised Ayurveda Institute
No separate experience requirement is specified for this post in the provided notification

rows.qualification: Diploma in Yoga Science (D.Y.Sc.) or Diploma in Yoga Therapy (DYT)
rows.experience: No separate experience requirement is specified in the provided notification

content_sections.heading: Senior Medical Officer Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Senior Medical Officer must possess BAMS along with an MD or MS in one of the specialities prescribed in the notification: Panchakarma, Prasuti Tantra and Stree Roga, Shalya Tantra, Kayachikitsa, Kaumarbhritya or Shalakya Tantra. The degree must be from a recognised university, Statutory State Board, Council or Faculty of Indian Medicine. Candidates must also be enrolled on the Central Register or State Register of Indian System of Medicine. A minimum of 5 years of experience is essential. Ten years of clinical and/or teaching experience in a recognised hospital or teaching institution is listed as desirable.

content_sections.heading: Panchakarma Technician Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: All three Panchakarma Technician levels require a Diploma or Certificate course in Panchakarma. Experience requirements vary according to seniority.

rows.required_experience: 10 years in Panchakarma techniques at a recognised Ayurveda Institute
5 years in Panchakarma techniques at a recognised Ayurveda Institute
No separate experience requirement is specified in the notification

content_sections.heading: DNH & DD AYUSH Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration according to the post.

content_sections.heading: DNH & DD AYUSH Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for all advertised posts will be based on interviews only. Applications will be scrutinised by the recruiting authority. Candidates found eligible after scrutiny will be shortlisted for the interview. Eligible candidates will be informed about the interview date, time and venue at least 7 days in advance through email and telephone. Final selection will be based on the interview. No written examination is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Interview Instructions
content_sections.text: Selection will be through interview only. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Eligible candidates will be informed at least 7 days in advance about the interview schedule through email and telephone. The Director, Medical & Health Services / Mission Director, National AYUSH Mission, DNH & DD reserves the right to terminate, modify, withdraw or cancel the selection process at any stage without assigning a reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DNH & DD AYUSH Recruitment 2026?
Q2. Which posts are available?
faq.answer: The vacancies are for Senior Medical Officer, Panchakarma Technician (Senior), Panchakarma Technician (Medium), Panchakarma Technician (Junior) and Yoga Instructor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the authority by 12 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through hard copy or email.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Senior Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need BAMS with MD/MS in one of the prescribed Ayurveda specialities, along with registration on the Central or State Register of Indian System of Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. What is the Panchakarma Technician qualification?
faq.answer: A Diploma or Certificate course in Panchakarma is required. The Senior post requires 10 years of experience, while the Medium post requires 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the Senior Medical Officer salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs.1,06,966/-.
